warrant_text: The probable cause is as follows: On 07/31/2026 police observed an individual outside 221 Broadway who kept getting into other individuals' faces and causing a disturbance. The individual, later identified as the defendant, then approached police. Police observed the defendant to be very unsteady on his feet, having slurred speech, and a strong odor of alcohol coming from his person.
